_comment_long: Storybook is NOT yet installed in this repo — the stories at
src/**/*.stories.tsx are authored forward-compatibly (CSF 8) so
when Storybook lands, Chromatic snapshots flow without
rewriting story files. This config file pins the snapshot
scope + expected-changed thresholds so the cross-cutting
Storybook phase only needs to add the `chromatic` CLI dep +
a CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN secret to start running.
When Chromatic is wired:
npx chromatic --project-token=$CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN
The CI workflow at .github/workflows/chromatic.yml runs this
on every PR. The workflow self-skips when CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN
is not set (e.g. forks, or before the secret is provisioned),
so this config + workflow can land NOW without breaking CI.
Snapshot scope (250.6.F.4): the AssetTypePickerStep stories
(default + 4 selected variants + skippable + future blocked
variant), the SchemaDriftBanner stories, and the KYC error UX
in PublicResourcesPage. Other components are out-of-scope for
the 250.6 phase but pick up snapshot coverage automatically
as their stories are added (Chromatic snapshots EVERY story
by default — the explicit allowlist below is a CI-time
filter, not an exclusion at story-author time).
